newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends lower vs dollar at 1,061.00.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends lower vs dollar at 1,061.00.

text.p: Colombia's peso ended one peso lower against the dollar at 1,061.00 in quiet trading on the interbank market, dealers said.
"It wasn't until the end of the session that slight demand (for dollars) drove the exchange rate up from the 1,060 level where it had held all day," one trader said.
He said the peso had held steady despite sporadic dollar sales by oil and coffee exporters.
"You can't say there was much speculating going on today because the market moved in a very tight 1,058.60-to-1,061.95 range," another trader said.
Dealers reported 284 trades for a thin total of $120 million.
